page.overview:
Who is Murmur?

"Murmur" is a playable character of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Ravager in White, she is a bodyguard of Sadali. Her "sisters" are "Grace" and "Whisper".

"Murmur" arrives with Sadali as his escort. After Garvall and Velne leave with the monks, "Murmur" asks Sadali about his intentions with Garvall. Sadali finds it laughable that Garvall thinks becoming the head of the Arms Dealer's Guild will ensure dignity for the people of Yezagh. He continues to laugh after stating the world cannot be without war.

"Murmur" is an MR-rarity unit of the Light element whose main job is Red Mage, while her sub jobs are Black Mage and Lancer. She can equip the following items: Sword, Hat, Clothing, Accessory. Her unit cost is 40.

Her Master Ability increases her own MAG by 20% and her Slash/Pierce/Strike/Missile/Magic Attack Resistance by 10%. She has no limit burst.
